name: Spooky Lighthouse
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
Sometimes late at night, our matrons at the orphanage will tell us spooky stories.  Those RULE!  There's one about a ghost that haunts a lighthouse in Westfall.  They say he was a pirate captain who had his ship taken from him by other pirates.  Wow!

Could you please take me to the lighthouse in Westfall?  I wanna see if the ghost of that captain is there!  I promise to stay close to you; I won't run off or anything!
narrative.objectives: Take the orphan to see the lighthouse off the coast of Westfall.
narrative.offerRewardText:
WOW, that was a real life ghost! That was so awesome - I can't wait to tell everyone back at the orphanage. Captain Grayson... he even looked like a pirate! When I grow up I wanna be a ghost pirate too!

Thanks for taking me to Westfall, adventurer. I know there are scary things out there in the wilds of Westfall, and I hope I wasn't too much of a pain. You're awesome!
